messages:
clare: Heads-up, saw a perf regression on staging Llama2-13B yesterday after kernel selector tweak.
clare: p50 went 38ms -> 62ms for gen short-chat (seq=64), p95 220ms -> 460ms, tokens/s dropped ~30%.
clare: profile shows selector choosing GEMM fallback on multi-head matmul for head_dim=128, seq<=64, which is weird.
perf-bot: automated profile summary: kernel_switch_count=312, avg_kernel_latency_increase=1.9x, kv_cache_evictions=14
dmitri: any recent changes? I pushed heuristic that prefers fused attention for >=128 head_dim but maybe we reversed condition.
sasha: can you paste the selector config + a minimal repro? also include batch composition.
clare: repro: single request stream of 64 tokens, batch size 4 w/ variable prompt prefix lengths. Selector config:
```
{"rules": [{"min_head_dim": 0, "max_head_dim": 128, "kernel": "matmul_opt"},
 {"min_head_dim": 129, "kernel": "fused_attn"}], "prefer_quantized": false}
```
clare: but runtime picked matmul_opt for head_dim=128 which triggers an un-optimized code path on A100 with Ampere kernels.
dmitri: ah, off-by-one. My rule used inclusive boundaries but kernel runtime expects exclusive upper bound. I'll add a test.
sasha: also check RoPE theta default scaling. We saw higher KV cache memory blowup when rope_theta scaled up, because k/v dims become misaligned and we end up with padded KV pages.
elaine: quick note: our chat template adds a persistent system prompt ~128 tokens which makes typical prefixes much longer; that increases seq_len for many requests and changes batching profile.
clare: experiment idea: patch selector to consider (head_dim * seq_len) and prefer fused_attn when product > 8192. Also cap continuous batching window to 20ms for small seqs.
dmitri: sounds good. I'll open a PR for selector and add unit tests for boundary cases. Also adding a perf test that runs seqs {16,64,256} with head_dims {64,128,192}.
perf-bot: perf regression ticket created: PERF-2147
sasha: try plugging in rmsnorm fused kernel too; we saw 8-12% wins on other models when SiLU present.
clare: timeline: patch and canary deploy tomorrow AM, if green roll to prod. Can someone run the repro job on a Dedicated node (p4d-ish) to see HW differences?
elaine: I can run it on dedicated. ping me the job link.
clare: job: `./tools/perf_run.sh --model llama2-13b --seq 64 --batch 4 --runs 100 --trace`.
dmitri: added CI perf job: https://ci.redwood/pipelines/PR-3787
sasha: if canary passes, follow up with kv-evict tweak: prefer LRU per-request, avoid global periodic eviction.
clare: thanks — will update thread with numbers. :thumbsup:
